alt: 兩名學生在棋盤前屏息對弈，周圍同學緊張旁觀，關鍵棋步尚未落下。
scene_prompt: Meaning: 劍拔弩張 describes a tense, confrontational atmosphere on the brink of conflict. Show two students facing one another across a chessboard during a close final move: both lean forward with serious focused expressions, one hand holds a chess piece just above the board while the other student braces a palm on the table, their posture creates palpable tension. Several classmates watch silently from behind. The board position is close and balanced; no weapons, no aggression or physical contact. Natural anatomy, exactly two arms and legs per visible person; hands correctly hold chess pieces and touch table. Stable table and chairs, consistent perspective. No text.
